chunks: From him, from Ahmad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu Ubayda, from Abu Ja'da, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

In the Book of Ali (peace be upon him): There are three characteristics whose owner will not die until he sees their evil consequences: tyranny, severing of the womb (kinship), and the false oath by which one confronts Allah. And indeed, the quickest obedience to receive reward is maintaining kinship. And indeed, people may be immoral yet maintain kinship ties, so their wealth increases and they become rich.

And indeed, the false oath and severing of kinship leave the houses empty of their inhabitants, and they cause the displacement of relatives; and indeed, the displacement of relatives is the cutting off of the lineage.
ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics whose owner sees their evil consequences before death, and how does kinship affect wealth?
ai.summary: Attributed to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and traced to the *Musnad* of Imam Ali (AS), this hadith identifies tyranny (*al-bagh*), severing kinship (*qati' al-rahim*), and false oaths as the three traits whose consequences are witnessed before death. It emphasizes that *silat al-rahim* yields the swiftest reward, noting that even the wicked prosper through it, whereas its absence leads to the desolation of dwellings and the extinction of lineage.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Abu Ubeyda, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> (it is written): ‘There are three characteristics, its owner would not be dying ever until he sees its evil results – the tyranny, and the severing of the relationship, and the false oath to oppose Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with it; and that the quickest Rewards for the obedience is for the maintaining of the relationship. And that the people could be happening to be immoral, but they are maintaining relationships, so their wealth increases and they become rich.

And the false oath and the severing of the relationships devastate the households by ruination from its inhabitants and transformation the relatives, and that the transformation of the relatives is cutting off of the lineages’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad from al- Hassan ibn Mahbub from Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah from abu ‘Ubaydah from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“It is written in the book of Ali (a.s.) ‘There are three characteristics, that if found in anyone, he will never die before suffering their consequences: treachery, failing to maintain good relations with relatives and taking a false oath to oppose Allah thereby. Of the acts of obedience with the quickest best result is to maintain good relations with relatives. A people may happen to be unjust in their affairs but maintain good relations with relatives, their wealth increases and they grow rich.

False oath and failing to maintain good relations with relatives can leave a town in mins, empty of the inhabitants and transform the family. Transformation of family is discontinuation of the lineage and reproduction.’”
